# Barney Pullen & Nettie Scobie

- [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md) — Spouse of — [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) — husband · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> In bed on New Year's Eve, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) proposes marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on behalf of her bashful brother, [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) firmly declines the proposal, causing [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) to react with cool indifference and note that [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) will likely marry [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) instead. After [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) leaves the next morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) laughs over the unromantic reality of her very first marriage proposal.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VIII Nell’s First Proposal

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 ch.Proposal P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 ch.Proposal P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) completes her term at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) while managing persistent suitors, including an unpleasant proposal from [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md). She receives a letter from her friend [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) proposing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) lease a house together for the upcoming school year. After searching without success, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stumble upon a 'To Let' sign on Tabby's Place in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris).
>
> — v3 · Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend
